justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/CodaBarReader.java` (343 lines, 8 methods total). The class has one main public behavior (`decodeRow`) plus a constructor; the remaining methods (`setCounters`, `findStartPattern`, `toNarrowWidePattern`, `validatePattern`, `counterAppend`, `arrayContains`) are small helpers that all support the same Codabar decoding pipeline. I did not see multiple independent responsibilities or a method/public API count that suggests it should be split further.
